# EvidInvest MCP Server — llms.txt

> Financial data and valuation tools for AI agents. 46 tools covering company fundamentals, market data, DCF analysis, growth trajectory and two-stage fair value, portfolio optimization, portfolio tracking, stock comparison, and SEC supply chain intelligence.

## Quick Start

Connect via MCP StreamableHTTP at `https://mcp.evidinvest.com/mcp` with `Authorization: Bearer evid_sk_...` header.

## What You Can Do

- Value any US-listed stock using DCF, PE, PEG, P/B, P/S, EV/EBITDA
- Get a bear/base/bull fair value range with a verdict (undervalued/fairly valued/overvalued)
- Compare up to 5 stocks side-by-side on valuation metrics
- Pull financial statements (income, balance sheet, cash flow) — annual or quarterly
- Get growth rates (CAGR) for revenue, EPS, equity across 1-30 year periods
- Calculate WACC, run margin of safety analysis, dividend discount models
- Optimize portfolios using Modern Portfolio Theory (max Sharpe, min variance)
- Decompose portfolio risk by position, sector, and factor
- Track portfolio holdings and compute weighted valuations

## Recommended Tool Order

For a complete stock analysis:
1. `get_company_snapshot` — overview
2. `get_fair_value_range` — is it cheap or expensive?
3. `get_cagr_matrix` — historical compound growth rates
4. `get_growth_trajectory` — EPS growth shape (ACCELERATING / STABLE / RECOVERY / DECELERATING / DETERIORATING) and two-stage DCF conservative-moderate-bull range
5. `get_dcf_valuation` — detailed intrinsic value
6. `get_reverse_dcf` — what the market expects

## Important Notes

- Data is updated daily, prices are EOD (not real-time)
- Financial companies: skip EV/EBITDA, use P/B instead
- Pre-profit companies: PE/PEG will be null, use P/S
- DCF fair values are sensitive to growth + discount rate assumptions — always mention this
- All values in the company's reporting currency (USD, EUR, SEK, etc.)
